motions.label: Look around
motions.description: Eyes follow a pointer across the visor.

motions.label: Wake
motions.description: Raises its head and flicks one hand when chat opens.

motions.label: Dock
motions.description: Lowers into its launcher when chat is minimized.

motions.label: Guide
motions.description: Looks left and points toward a form field.

motions.label: Think
motions.description: A lime scan crosses the visor while a reply is prepared.

motions.label: Reply
motions.description: Looks up, smiles and gives a small nod.

motions.label: Unread reply
motions.description: The antenna flashes once when a reply arrives in the launcher.

motions.label: Network mismatch
motions.description: An amber visor and tilted head ask for a network check.

motions.label: Quote expired
motions.description: The visor dims and the antenna lowers when a quote expires.

motions.label: Confirmation pending
motions.description: A cool blue scan marks a transaction still in progress.

motions.label: QR courier
motions.description: Extends a hand toward a payment QR card.

motions.label: Receipt ready
motions.description: Lifts a receipt when a transaction is confirmed.

motions.label: Needs attention
motions.description: Reacts with a restrained recoil and a rose visor.
